basics.name: Xuan Kan
basics.label: Senior Research Scientist
basics.summary: Senior Research Scientist at Meta Monetization GenAI working on reinforcement learning, language model evaluation and reward modeling, and multimodal LLMs.

work.name: Monetization GenAI, Meta
highlights: Designed and implemented an end-to-end agentic RL framework for ads image generation, combining policy optimization with multimodal reward signals and extending the framework toward video ads generation agents.
Led the design of a multimodal automated evaluation system from prompt design through SFT and RL to scalably assess LLM/VLM-generated ad creatives, with findings published in peer-reviewed venues.
Built a user preference prediction model for automatic creative variant selection, achieving a 40%+ save-rate lift in A/B tests.

work.name: Ads Core ML, Meta
work.summary: Designed and built new ads models for the Signal Loss problem.

work.name: Federated Assistant Team, Google
work.summary: Employed federated learning and parameter-efficient transfer learning to reduce ASR data requirements and communication costs between servers and clients.
